title: ChartQuest Canonical Pattern Object
description: THE single source of truth for the shape of every ChartQuest pattern. A pattern is a reusable, first-class educational building block: an authored candle sequence that teaches ONE named concept, functions as walkable terrain, and hosts a trade setup. No document, code path, or tool may define pattern structure anywhere else. This schema EXTENDS the ratified architecture — it never duplicates it: geometry/readability rules are owned by the Visual Market Constitution, trade truth by the Trading canon, lesson sequencing by the Curriculum Engine. Version 1.0.0, ratified 2026-07-15.
$comment: FROZEN DECISIONS (see CHARTQUEST_PATTERN_DECISION_RECORDS.md): (P1) This schema is the sole definition of pattern structure. (P2) Patterns REFERENCE the Visual Market Constitution for ALL candle geometry/readability; `requiredVisualRules` points to it and validation delegates to its chart validators — a pattern never restates a pixel rule. (P3) The Pattern Library owns the Concept Catalogue: concept identity and concept->masteryCategory (Curriculum decision D5). `primaryConcept`/`supportingConcepts` are conceptKeys the catalogue defines; masteryCategory is DERIVED from the catalogue, never stored on the pattern. (P4) A pattern anchors exactly ONE `primaryConcept`; many patterns may share a concept. (P5) OWNERSHIP — patterns own market structure, visual educational intent, trade-opportunity PLACEMENT (visual), traversal geometry, emotional beat, concept identity; lessons own learning sequence, flow, notebook, replay sequence, trade scripting. No overlap. (P6) Trade OUTCOME/probability/causality is owned by trading_canon.md + Trading Experience System; a pattern says only WHERE the decisive candle sits and HOW CLEARLY it reads. (P7) Validation delegates: visual->Visual Market Constitution validators, educational/sequence->Curriculum VR-*, pattern-structural->this suite's PR-* (CHARTQUEST_PATTERN_VALIDATION_CONTRACTS.md). (P8) The Lesson->Pattern link is Lesson.learn.patternRef / Lesson.requiredPatterns[] -> Pattern.patternId; patterns declare lesson COMPATIBILITY (allowed/forbidden) but never hard-couple to a concrete lessonId.

patternId.description: Stable kebab-case id (matches the Constitution's 'Pattern ID'). This is the id a Lesson's patternRef points to.

uuid.description: Stable machine id, assigned once at Draft, never reused.

version.description: Content version, e.g. '1.0'. Simple; no SemVer ceremony (Curriculum D8).

status.description: Lifecycle state (see the pattern state machine in CHARTQUEST_PATTERN_OBJECT_MODEL.md). A pattern reaches 'approved' only when every applicable validator PASSes; only 'approved'+ patterns may be referenced by a production lesson.

primaryConcept.description: The ONE concept this pattern anchors (P4). A conceptKey from the Concept Catalogue (owned here, P3), matching the live short snake_case keys (bos, choch, support_resist, pullback, momentum, …).

supportingConcepts.description: Secondary conceptKeys the pattern reinforces (may be assumed only if taught earlier; enforced by the Curriculum teach-order DAG, VR-ORDER).

educationalPurpose.description: One sentence, 10-year-old wording: what the player should feel or understand. Names the same concept as primaryConcept (the Constitution's 'Purpose' field).

difficultyTier.description: How hard the pattern is to read/traverse. Expressed via chart type, density, rhythm, and exaggeration-gain — NEVER by dropping below the Constitution's readability floor.

marketStructure.description: The pattern's structural shape — what the market is DOING. The five gold-standard reference patterns are impulse / pullback / breakout / range / reversal.

patternFamily.description: Taxonomy grouping for library indexing and lesson selection.

patternCategory.description: Optional finer sub-taxonomy within a family (e.g. 'bullish-impulse').

chartTypes.description: Which Visual Market Constitution chart type(s) this pattern renders as (A illustration / B terrain / C exam). Each rendered instance is exactly ONE type and is validated as that type; a pattern may transition A->B->C across a level.

requiredCandleVocabulary.description: Candle terms the reader must already know (body, wick, close, doji, …). Assumed-taught, enforced by VR-ORDER.

requiredTerrainCharacteristics.description: The candles-as-terrain surface the pattern OWNS (traversal geometry). Values are pattern intent; the numeric floors they must satisfy live in the Visual Market Constitution (referenced, not restated).

targetVisibleCount.description: Authored on-screen candle count; with the Constitution's slot rule this determines bodyW.

rhythmProfile.description: Human summary of the traversal rhythm (e.g. 'one long impulse run then a rest step').

requiredVisualRules.description: REFERENCE to the Visual Market Constitution (P2) — the pattern does not restate geometry. Declares which type/floors apply so validators can be run.

chartType.description: The type of THIS rendered instance (selects BW band, density, readability floor).

exaggerationGain.description: Position on the Constitution's exaggeration-gain ramp (1.0 = Type-A illustration, 0.0 = realistic Type-C).

playtestRecordRef.description: Link to the required >=5-child, >=90%, >=1-CVD Human Playtest Gate result (Constitution). Required to ship.

requiredEmotionalBeat.description: The emotional/narrative beat the pattern OWNS (P5). 10-year-old wording. A Lesson may frame it, but the beat originates with the pattern.

expectedPlayerObservation.description: What a player SHOULD notice by looking (understand-by-looking, per the Constitution). 10-yr wording.

expectedBeginnerMistake.description: The wrong read a beginner is likely to make — feeds the lesson's misconception handling (Lesson.misconceptions).

allowedLessons.description: Lesson COMPATIBILITY (P8): lessonIds (or ['any']) this pattern may serve. Compatibility only — the lesson decides actual usage.

forbiddenLessons.description: Lessons this pattern must never serve (e.g. a Type-C exam-only pattern forbidden from a first LEARN).

allowedTradeTypes.description: Which trade directions the setup visually supports. Outcome/causality NOT decided here (P6).

tradeOpportunities.description: WHERE the decisive setup sits and HOW CLEARLY it reads — visual layer only (P6). Placement must let a level reach >=3 trades before its boss (VR-GATE). Outcome/probability owned by trading_canon.md.

decisiveCandle.description: Which candle in the sequence is the decision point (e.g. 'the breakout close', index or label).

readsAs.description: The visual evidence a 10-year-old reads (e.g. 'strong close past the high').

tradeTruthRef.description: Pointer to the trading_canon/TES scenario that owns the actual outcome — never an outcome value here.

replayCompatibility.description: May this pattern be shown in the post-trade replay? The replay SEQUENCE is owned by the Lesson (P5); this only declares suitability.

notebookCompatibility.description: May this pattern seed a notebook entry? Notebook content owned by the Lesson.

journalCompatibility.description: May trades on this pattern produce a journal entry?

analyticsEvents.description: Content-event names a rendered instance emits (Block-4 event engine).

validationRules.description: Ids that must PASS before the pattern enters the library (P7). PR-* resolve in CHARTQUEST_PATTERN_VALIDATION_CONTRACTS.md; VR-* in the Curriculum's CHARTQUEST_VALIDATION_CONTRACTS.md; V-* (chart validators) in the Visual Market Constitution. No rule is re-defined here.

dependencies.description: Prerequisite patternIds (e.g. a 'breakout' pattern depends on a 'range' pattern existing). Must form a DAG (PR-DAG).
